comments.body:
Debug-orchestrator session: PAUSED at operator instruction ("cancel the loop, allow the
subagents to complete, remain paused once they complete"). Loop cancelled, CI monitor
stopped, no new dispatch. This entry closes out the final subagent.

## Completed after the pause instruction

Subagent 1ef8 (review-bot gate-scratch bypass) reported with change 2622 green but
deliberately unsubmitted and its ticket left in_progress. Per the interpretation stated to
the operator before pausing -- finish what the running agents started, submit only on a
genuine double-green, then stop -- I finished it and nothing else.

- Verified 2622's votes MYSELF via /a/changes/2622/detail?o=LABELS rather than trusting the
  subagent's report: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved.
- Submitted (HTTP 200, MERGED). Landed as 5932f4951b27 with NO server rebase -- submitted
  sha equals reviewed sha.
- Proved the close worktree reaches it: `git merge-base --is-ancestor` OK and
  `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` -> OK, resolved 1ef8-c849-5801-4eee.
- Closed 1ef8 as `--class preexisting`. GATE_PEAK_RSS 436371456 (~416 MB) in 80.8s.

## Two close refusals, both resolved WITHOUT --force

1. Bug closes require `--class`. Chose `preexisting` over my instinct `plan_defect` because
   the ticket's own description states "This is a gap in the architecture, not a defect in
   S1" -- the filing explicitly rejects the plan-defect reading. Checking the ticket beat
   guessing from the class table.
2. Five ACs were unchecked (the subagent proved them but never ticked them). Verified each
   independently at the merged sha before checking any box: all three named tests exist in
   tests/unit/test_review_bot.py; scratch_unavailable_detail is in llm/gate_admission.py AND
   forwarded from review_bot/low_disk.py (promotion, not copy); the AC5 pin holds (zero
   marker literals under src/rebar/review_bot/); observability.sh names the shared constant.

## Change 2623 (epic 6202 S2) -- NOT submitted, correctly

Came back -1 on BOTH gates. Recorded in full on ticket 9183. Two unrelated causes:

- Verified -1 is CONFIRMED base drift, not a code fault: parent 3ae5c7a6082c has zero
  occurrences of grounding-terraform; c57057f41 adds it. Four legs failed uniformly in
  40-71s at the install step. Remedy is REBASE, explicitly not `recheck` -- it reproduces
  from the base, so it fails the "provably environmental" test.
- LLM-Review -1 is ONE REAL BLOCKING CORRECTNESS FINDING and it hits the story's crux:
  docker_unaccounted_bytes subtracts the full `docker system df` ledger (Images +
  Containers + Build Cache) from a `du` of overlay2 ALONE, but BuildKit cache lives under
  /var/lib/docker/buildkit. The two measurements do not span the same bytes, so the residue
  is systematically under-reported by the size of the build cache. I had previously
  reported this crux as working; that was wrong and is corrected on the ticket.

Second changesbase-drift case in one evening (1ef8 PS1 was the first). Not filed at n=2;
a third occurrence would justify a ticket.

## Meta-pattern, fourth instance

The docker-storage-cap.sh advisory -- reporting builder.gc "in effect" after a SIGHUP
reload that does not apply it -- is the same ABSENCE OF EXECUTION REPORTED AS SUCCESS family
as 9a17 (worker kill), 90c7 (vacuous vote), and 1ef8's own vacuous AC3 (tempfile.gettempdir
memoisation making a monkeypatched TMPDIR inert).

## Housekeeping

Reaped four redundant waiter processes I had accumulated while polling. No PPID-1 orphans;
every helper was alarm-bounded via `perl -e 'alarm N; exec @ARGV'` since `timeout` does not
exist on this host (returns 127, silent no-op -- bug 0d6c).

## State at pause

Fourteen changes merged this session; ten tickets closed. Epic 6202: S0+S6+S1 landed,
S2 (9183) blocked on a real design correction, S3 (e956) / S4 (2ba3) / S5 (910b) still held
behind it on the shared compose-up.sh / observability.sh / monitoring_autodeploy.tf /
review-bot-ops.md file set. Awaiting branch-head run 33894700851 on 5932f4951b27 to confirm
main stayed green after the merge.

Open and unworked: 0d6c, a1f1 (rescoped), 6f66, 7f46. Operator-reserved: 337e (chromium
tier), f850 (Windows sweep), bff5 AC3 (production fault-injection). 3276 remains blocked on
epic 6202's caps. 90c7 and b973 belong to another session.
